library.title: Record a marketing authorisation decision
library.intro: What the decision-maker states when an application is decided: the outcome the law provides, what is authorised, its conditions, when it takes effect and ends, the provision relied on, the reasons and how to ask for a review. The decision is made and sealed in the case by an official who can sign, different from the one who proposed it.
library.filled_by: The official with the power to decide, signed in; a different official proposed it (four-eyes).
library.authority: The medicines regulator the nation names under Who is responsible. The deployment profile has no medicines-regulator slot yet, so the health regulator slot (healthRegulation) stands for it; each power over a product type comes from the approved permit authority mapping; never a ministry by name.
library.intended: The decision step of the marketing authorisation procedure of the medicines regulator, sealed by the case engine and written to a product register: not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I4).

policies.decision.authority: the permit authority mapping for the product type (none ships)
policies.decision.four_eyes: proposed by one official, decided by a different official who can sign

nation_values.decision: How long a marketing authorisation is valid, where the law limits it.
The days to ask for a reconsideration or appeal of a decision.

deviations.what: The decision is made and sealed by the case engine under an approved procedure (four-eyes, the decision key, the law version cited), never by submitting this form; the form records what the decision-maker states
deviations.why: Every decision cites the law version and is signed; AI never makes a legally material decision.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: cases change only through lib/casework/engine.ts

deviations.what: No outcome, measure or route ships in its list: each is a power or route the nation's law provides, configured with the approved permit mapping
deviations.why: The platform never invents or assumes a decision power.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: lib/permits/authority.ts, powerRefusal(); never hardcode a power

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: records of products, of organisations (holders, manufacturers, importers) and of the regulator's decisions.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The deployment profile has no medicines-regulator slot: the health regulator slot (healthRegulation, "Health facility regulation") stands for the medicines regulator until one is added; each power over a product type comes from the approved permit authority mapping
deviations.why: Who is responsible comes only from the deployment profile and the permit authority registry; the platform never names a ministry or assumes an institution (integration register 20.9).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(), lib/permits/authority.ts; never assume a ministry by name

deviations.what: The regulated product record (Part 6 §5.2) is not on the platform yet: a reference to an authorised product is recorded as given and its check recorded as not performed, a product's status is shown nowhere until the regulator's product register exists, and it is never inferred from an import, inventory or procurement record
deviations.why: Each status must come from the competent regulator's authoritative record; a register is built with its procedures, not stood in for by a form.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register (20.5 registers a form references that are not on the platform; 20.9); Part 6 §5.2

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
